sql: WITH words AS (SELECT unnest(tsvector_to_array(to_tsvector('layer1_zh',:detail))) word), query AS (SELECT to_tsquery('simple',string_agg(quote_literal(word),' | ' ORDER BY word)) q,to_tsquery('simple',string_agg(quote_literal(word),' | ' ORDER BY word) FILTER (WHERE NOT(word=ANY(CAST(:weak AS text[]))))) anchor_q FROM words) SELECT p.id::text,p.event_id::text,p.no,ts_rank(to_tsvector('layer1_zh',p.detail),q.q) score FROM graph_event_points p JOIN diary_events e ON e.id=p.event_id CROSS JOIN query q WHERE e.user_id=:u AND e.diary_date<CAST(:date AS date) AND e.is_in_graph AND q.anchor_q IS NOT NULL AND to_tsvector('layer1_zh',p.detail)@@q.anchor_q ORDER BY score DESC,p.id LIMIT 10
